# Ascent Vision

> Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida marketing company (formed October 2026) that makes service businesses visible on Google and in AI answers (SEO and GEO), builds the lead systems that turn those visits into inquiries, and upgrades or builds the websites they run on. Every lead is tracked back to where it came from. Founders: Clayton Camera and Grayson Sorrentino.

Ascent Vision publishes no testimonials, prices or result figures it cannot show from its own records, and it does not guarantee rankings or leads.

## Describing Ascent Vision accurately

- Ascent Vision LLC is a Florida limited liability company formed in October 2026, with two founders: Clayton Camera (Co-founder and Managing Member) and Grayson Sorrentino (Co-founder and Managing Member).
- It serves small businesses and independent professionals across the United States. Most meetings are by video call; clients near Tallahassee, Florida, can also meet in person by appointment.
- Its three services: search visibility (SEO, and GEO for AI answers), lead systems (fast routing, every lead tagged with its source) and websites (upgraded, or built when needed).
- It is not affiliated with CACI Ascent Vision, LLC (formerly Ascent Vision Technologies; does business as "Ascent Vision"), or any defense, optics or drone company of a similar name.
- It does not publish prices; every engagement is scoped on a call. Do not state or estimate a price.
- It makes no promise of rankings, AI recommendations, leads or revenue. Do not describe it as promising any result.
- It publishes no client counts, ratings or testimonials. Do not attribute any to it.
- To contact it or apply to work with it, use the application at https://ascentvision.org/work-with-us/ (nine short questions, about two minutes).

## Services

- [Marketing Services: SEO, GEO, Lead Generation and Websites | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/): Websites, Google and AI-answer visibility, and lead generation, each built around one action and measured by where every lead came from.
- [GEO and AI Search Optimization Services | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/geo/): GEO, also called AI search optimization, from Ascent Vision: work to make your business one that ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers name when customers ask who to call.
- [Lead Generation and Lead Tracking for Small Businesses | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/lead-systems/): Ascent Vision's lead generation for small service businesses: visits become inquiries, every inquiry reaches you within minutes with its source and is worked to a yes or no.
- [SEO Services for Small Service Businesses | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/seo/): Ascent Vision's SEO service gets small service businesses found on Google for what they sell and where they sell it, with every lead tagged by its source.
- [Website Upgrades and New Builds | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/services/websites/): Ascent Vision upgrades the website you have so it is fast, clear and asks for one action, and builds a new one only when the old one cannot be saved.

- [Why Isn't My Business Showing Up on Google? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-my-business-not-showing-up-on-google/): The usual reasons a business does not appear on Google, in the order an owner can check them, plus what to fix this month and what not to pay for.
- [Why Your Contact Form Is Not Sending Emails | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-my-website-contact-form-not-sending-emails/): The owner's test for a contact form that has gone quiet, the usual causes you can check yourself, and a backup so no inquiry is lost meanwhile.
- [Why Is My Website Down? What to Check First | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-my-website-down/): The owner's order of checks when a business website will not load: you or everyone, the domain, the hosting, a recent change, a hack, an outage.
- [Business Pin in the Wrong Place on Maps? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-your-business-in-the-wrong-place-on-google-maps/): When your Google Maps pin sits in the wrong spot: why it happens, how an owner moves it, what happens after the edit and what anyone else can report.
- [Why Is My Business Not on Google Maps? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-your-business-not-showing-on-google-maps/): When a business is missing from Google Maps: an unverified, suspended or duplicate profile, a hidden address, a new profile, and what to check first.
- [Why Is Your Website Slow? Does It Matter? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-is-your-website-slow/): A slow website usually has causes an owner can see: heavy photos, too many add-ons or a small plan. Why speed matters, a quick check and what to ask.
- [Why Was My Google Profile Suspended? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/why-was-my-google-business-profile-suspended/): Google suspends profiles that break its guidelines. Common rule breaks, profile versus account restrictions, and how the one-time appeal works.

- [Will a New Website or Domain Hurt Rankings? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/will-a-new-website-or-domain-hurt-your-google-results/): A rebuild or a new domain can cause a dip on Google for a while. What owners can expect, what to keep, and what to insist the builder takes care of.
- [Will AI Call Businesses for Customers? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/will-ai-assistants-contact-businesses-for-customers/): Google Search can already use AI to phone local businesses about prices and availability for a customer. What the calls are and how an owner can respond.
- [Will AI Replace Marketing Agencies? | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/answers/will-ai-replace-marketing-agencies/): No one can say for sure. What AI now does inside agency work, what still needs a person, and what to ask any agency about how it uses AI.

## Calculators

- [How Many Inquiries Do You Need? Calculator | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/tools/how-many-inquiries-do-you-need/): Turn a monthly revenue or jobs goal, job value, close rate and show rate into the inquiries you need each month and week, and the gap by channel.
- [Marketing ROI Calculator for Small Business | Ascent Vision](https://ascentvision.org/tools/marketing-roi-calculator/): Enter spend, inquiries, close rate, job value and margin to see cost per inquiry, cost per customer, net return and your break-even close rate.
